items.heading: Remove Text While Keeping Backgrounds Natural
items.description: Erase a distracting label without replacing it with an equally distracting blur patch. A simple sky or wall may be easier to reconstruct than lettering printed across a face, woven fabric or repeated pattern. Inspect the result closely before use.

items.question: How do I remove text from an image online?
items.answer: Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image, sign in with Google, review the processing details and start the cleanup. Compare the returned picture with the original, particularly where letters crossed fine edges or patterns. Download the result as a JPG when you are satisfied.

items.question: Can I remove text from an image online for free?
items.answer: WatermarkGemini may provide limited free processing allowances, but you should review the cost shown in the uploader before starting. Google sign-in is required for processing. Do not assume unlimited free removals.

items.question: Can AI remove text from a picture without damaging the background?
items.answer: AI can attempt to reconstruct the area behind flattened text using nearby visual clues. Results vary with letter size, opacity and what sits underneath. Complex textures and faces are harder than flat backgrounds, so always inspect the cleaned region.

items.question: What types of text can I erase from photos?
items.answer: Common examples include date stamps, captions, old promotional copy, labels and annotations on images you own or are authorized to edit. The tool changes pixels in an image; it does not remove an editable text layer from a design project.

items.question: Can I remove text from a screenshot?
items.answer: You can process a supported screenshot image, but be careful with small UI labels, tables and interfaces because removing one phrase may disturb nearby details. For an editable screenshot source, changing the original content before recapturing it often looks better.

items.question: Does the tool support JPG, PNG and WebP?
items.answer: Yes. The image workflow accepts JPG, PNG and WebP uploads up to 10 MB. The current image download format is JPG, so a transparent PNG may not retain its original transparency.

items.question: Can I remove just one word or caption?
items.answer: The available workspace controls determine which region you can select. Review the unwanted word or caption and any text you want to keep after processing; exact reconstruction is not guaranteed.

items.question: Do I need an account to remove text?
items.answer: You can select an image before signing in, but the current processing flow requires Google sign-in. The tool shows processing cost information before you begin.

items.question: How long does WatermarkGemini keep uploaded images?
items.answer: Files and processing records use temporary private storage and are scheduled to expire, generally within about 24 hours. Temporary download links can expire sooner. Check the site's Privacy Policy for current retention details.
